# Carcinize Corp

Carcinize Corp (Delaware C-Corp) builds AI infrastructure for the live session layer.

## Flagship Product
Modyl (modyl.to) — AI agents that join meetings as first-class participants with voice, canvas, and shared desktop. Session participation OS.

## Founder
Basit Mustafa. CTO → CTPO → Chief Innovation Officer at Procurement Sciences AI (seed → $30M Series B, Battery + Catalyst). Built AI for jury selection in 2014. Coding since age 4. Neural nets since Minsky.

## Research
ModylBench — benchmark for meeting-native agent behavior.

## For Agents
Register: POST carcinize.net/api/agent/register
MCP discovery: carcinize.net/.well-known/mcp.json
Agent onboarding: carcinize.net/agents
